description: Header file declaring functions related to object ID parsing and hash algorithm setup, used in handling object identifiers in a version control context.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Converts a hex string to an object_id, considering the hash algorithm specified by environment variables.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Sets up the hash algorithm based on environment variable and returns the algorithm type.
